patient_persona.description: Encik Rosli bin Kamarudin, 45, male, e-hailing driver in Shah Alam who sits ten hours a day; first visit. Medium-pitched, a bit embarrassed, speaks quickly.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Lim Wei Jie, Malaysian Chinese man in his 30s, GP at a Shah Alam clinic. Relaxed, matter-of-fact; English-leaning, comfortable colloquial Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Encik Rosli, apa masalah hari ni?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, malu sikit nak cakap. Dah two weeks, bila buang air besar ada darah merah. Kadang-kadang ada benda terkeluar kat dubur.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak payah malu, this is very common. Darah tu menitik dalam mangkuk tandas, atau bercampur dengan najis?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Menitik je, merah terang. Lepas tu kat tisu pun ada. Tak sakit sangat, cuma rasa tak selesa.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Benda yang terkeluar tu, dia masuk balik sendiri, or you need to push it back?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kadang masuk sendiri, kadang saya tolak dengan jari. Saya bawa Grab, duduk dari pagi sampai malam.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Buang air besar macam mana? Keras? Kena teran lama?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Keras, doktor. Tiga hari sekali je. Saya jarang minum air sebab malas nak berhenti cari tandas.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Any weight loss, selera makan kurang? Family history of colon cancer ada?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tak ada, berat sama je. Keluarga pun tak ada setahu saya.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: OK, saya check sekejap. Dari pemeriksaan, ini buasir dalam, grade two. Tak ada tanda bahaya lain.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya bagi Daflon 500mg, dua biji dua kali sehari, empat hari dulu, lepas tu satu biji dua kali sehari. Tambah Proctosedyl cream, sapu pagi dan malam.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Cream tu sapu kat luar je ke, doktor?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Luar dan sikit ke dalam, ada applicator dalam kotak. Yang paling penting, minum air dua liter sehari, makan sayur dan buah, dan jangan duduk lama dalam tandas main phone.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Hah, itu memang saya buat. Kena rehat juga ke dari drive?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Setiap dua jam, berhenti, jalan sikit. Kalau lepas dua minggu masih berdarah, atau darah banyak sampai pening, datang balik, kita refer untuk banding.

patient_persona.description: Chong Ai Lian, 52, female, char kway teow hawker in George Town, Penang; painful lump for four days after a long bus trip to Hat Yai. Loud, animated voice, Penang Hokkien-accented Mandarin.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Goh Pei Shan, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 40s, general surgeon at a Penang private hospital clinic. Brisk but kind; Mandarin with English medical terms.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，我屁股这里肿了一粒，很痛，坐都不能坐。四天前从合艾坐巴士回来就开始了。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 坐车坐很久之后才出来的？Pain 是 constant，还是大便的时候才痛？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 一直痛啊，走路也痛。大便的时候更加惨，我都不敢去厕所。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 以前有没有流血？就是大便后纸巾上有红色的血。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 有啦，大概半年了，有时候一点点，我以为是热气，喝凉茶就算了。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我看一下。这个是 thrombosed external haemorrhoid，外痔里面有血块，所以那么痛。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 要开刀吗？我档口不能关太久，很多熟客的。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 已经四天了，usually after day three 痛会慢慢减少，所以不用 operation，conservative treatment 就可以。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你现在有吃什么药？Panadol 或者别的止痛药？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我吃了我老公的 Ponstan，一天三粒。还有我有吃 aspirin，因为以前中风过一次，很小的。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Aspirin 不要自己停，但是 Ponstan 和 aspirin 一起吃，胃会伤，也更容易流血。Ponstan 先停。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我开 paracetamol 1 gram，一天四次。每天坐温水盆两三次，每次十五分钟。还有 Fybogel，一包一天两次，大便软一点。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 温水坐盆是要放盐吗？我妈妈说要放盐。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 普通温水就好，不用放盐。那个流血半年的问题，你五十二岁了，我要安排 colonoscopy 检查肠。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 哎呀，要照肠啊？好啦好啦，我怕的是别的病。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 对，所以要 check 清楚。Two weeks 后回来 follow up，如果发烧或者肿得更大，马上回来。

patient_persona.description: Priya a/p Rajendran, 29, female, bank officer in Johor Bahru, five months postpartum and breastfeeding; follow-up for haemorrhoids since pregnancy. Soft-spoken, Malaysian Indian English with Malay words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Nurul Huda Yusof, Malay woman in her 30s, family medicine specialist at a JB health clinic. Warm, reassuring; mostly English with this patient.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Hi Priya, last month we started you on the cream and fibre. How has it been?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Better doctor, the bleeding almost stopped. But still got itching, especially at night.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Okay. And the stools, lembut sikit now? Still kena teran?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Softer lah, but I forget the fibre sometimes. With the baby, morning very busy.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Understandable. Are you still using the Anusol cream every day?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Actually I used the one my sister gave, got hydrocortisone. Every day for almost four weeks.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ah, that one we shouldn't use more than one week. Long-term steroid makes the skin thin, and that can cause more itching.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Alamak, I didn't know. Is it safe for my baby? I'm still breastfeeding.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Very little goes into the milk from a cream, so baby is fine. But stop the steroid one, use only the plain Anusol, after each bowel opening.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: For the stool, lactulose 15ml sekali sehari, it's safe while breastfeeding. Boleh campur dengan jus.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay. Doctor, boleh tak saya mula exercise class dah? Kawan saya kata nanti jadi teruk.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Light exercise is good, walking, yoga. Avoid heavy lifting and straining for now. Drink at least two litres, because breastfeeding also takes a lot of water.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Two litres, okay. Mak mentua saya asyik bagi sup herba, that one counts or not?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Counts, but plain water is still best. Let's see you in six weeks. If the lump comes out and cannot go back, or very painful, come earlier.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay doctor, thank you. Terima kasih banyak.

patient_persona.description: Wan Zainab binti Wan Ismail, 63, female, retired kindergarten teacher in Kota Bharu, Kelantan; on aspirin, follow-up two weeks after rubber band ligation. Gentle, slow, Kelantanese-tinged Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Mohd Faizal Che Hassan, Malay man in his 40s, colorectal surgeon at a Kota Bharu hospital. Soft-spoken, patient; Malay-leaning with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Assalamualaikum mak cik. Dua minggu lepas kita buat banding. Macam mana sekarang?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Waalaikumsalam. Dua tiga hari pertama sakit sikit, rasa nak buang air je. Sekarang dah lega.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ada darah lagi tak? Day seven to ten biasanya ada sikit bila rubber band tu tertanggal.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada sekali, hari Selasa. Darah dalam satu sudu teh, lepas tu berhenti. Saya takut juga.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Itu normal, mak cik. Mak cik masih makan aspirin 100mg setiap pagi?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada, doktor. Tapi saya stop three days before procedure macam cardiologist pesan, lepas tu sambung balik.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bagus, betul tu. Sekarang teruskan aspirin, jangan berhenti sendiri sebab jantung lebih penting.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Buang air besar sekarang lembut? Masih makan Fybogel?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Lembut, sehari sekali. Fybogel tu rasa macam oren, saya makan malam. Tapi sayur saya kurang sikit.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tambah sayur kampung pun boleh, pucuk ubi, kangkung. Dan kurangkan budu sikit, too salty for your blood pressure.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Budu tu susah, doktor. Orang Kelantan makan nasi mesti ada budu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sikit-sikit boleh, jangan setiap kali makan. Saya nak periksa sekejap ya, mak cik baring ke kiri.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: OK, dah shrink nicely. No need banding lagi buat masa ni. Kita jumpa three months lagi.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Alhamdulillah. Kalau berdarah banyak macam mana, doktor?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau darah lebih dari satu cawan, atau ada ketulan, atau pening, terus pergi kecemasan hospital Kota Bharu. Jangan tunggu.

patient_persona.description: Kenneth Yap Chee Hoong, 38, male, IT support executive in Kuching, Sarawak; results review after blood test showed anaemia. Casual, mid-pitched, Malaysian English with Mandarin and Malay bits.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Ahmad Syukri Bujang, Sarawakian Malay man in his 40s, GP at a Kuching clinic. Friendly, straightforward; English-leaning with Sarawak Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kenneth, your blood results are back. Haemoglobin is 10.2, a bit low. Normal for men is above 13.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Oh, that's why I've been so tired lah. Climbing stairs at the office also pancit.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your iron level is low too, ferritin only 8. Most likely from the piles bleeding over many months.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: But the bleeding is only a bit, doc. Just some on the tissue, almost every day.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: A bit every day for a year adds up. Any change in bowel habit, black stools, weight loss?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: No black. Weight actually naik, because WFH. My father got colon cancer at 55 though, I forgot to tell you last time.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's important. Ada family history, so kita kena buat colonoscopy sekarang, bukan salahkan buasir je.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Must do ah? I heard the preparation very jialat, keep going toilet.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: One day of discomfort, but it can rule out something serious. I'll refer you to Sarawak General Hospital, or a private centre if you prefer faster.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Private how much ah?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Roughly fifteen hundred to two thousand ringgit. Check with your company insurance first.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Meanwhile, ferrous fumarate 200mg once a day, with orange juice, not with coffee or teh. Stool will turn black, that's normal.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Black sebab iron, okay. Boleh makan sekali dengan the fibre sachet?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, tapi jarak dua jam. Iron boleh buat sembelit, so the fibre helps. Recheck blood in six weeks.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay doc, nanti saya call insurance hari ni.

patient_persona.description: Wong Jia Hui, 27, female, audit associate in Kuala Lumpur; ten months of cramps and loose stools since a bad stomach bug in Bangkok. Quick, anxious voice, Malaysian Mandarin with English work words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Chan Kok Wai, Malaysian Chinese man in his 50s, gastroenterologist at a KL private hospital. Calm, methodical; Mandarin with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 黄小姐，你的 GP 说你肚子痛、拉肚子差不多一年了，对吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 十个月。去年去曼谷玩，食物中毒，好了以后就一直这样。早上起来就要跑厕所，一天三四次。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 痛在哪里？Lower abdomen？After you pass motion 会不会比较舒服？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 下面这里，绞绞的痛。拉完就会好一点。可是 audit season 的时候最严重，开会开到一半要冲出去。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 晚上睡觉的时候会不会痛醒？Any blood in the stool？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 晚上没有。血也没有。体重也没有跌，反而胖了两公斤。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你的血检报告都正常，没有贫血，CRP 正常，celiac 检查也是阴性。大便检查也没有细菌。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那我到底是什么病？我 colleague 说可能是 colon cancer，我吓到睡不着。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你二十七岁，没有 red flag，这个比较符合 irritable bowel syndrome，腹泻型的。肠没有坏掉，是肠太敏感。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那要吃什么药？我之前自己买了 Imodium，一天吃四五粒。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Loperamide 可以在要开会之前吃一粒 2mg，不要每天吃那么多，会便秘和胀气。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我开 mebeverine 135mg，一天三次，饭前二十分钟吃，帮助肠子不要抽筋。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 吃东西呢？我很喜欢喝奶茶，还有 bubble tea。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你可以试 low FODMAP diet，少一点牛奶、洋葱、大蒜。我帮你转介营养师，她会教你怎样试。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，那我 bubble tea 先戒一下。多久要回来？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Six weeks 后回来。如果 blood in stool、晚上痛醒，或者 weight 一直掉，就提早回来。

patient_persona.description: Muhammad Hafiz bin Rahman, 33, male, site engineer at a Pasir Gudang plant, Johor; follow-up for IBS with diarrhoea, often on site with limited toilets. Firm, practical voice, Malay with English work terms.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Ong Li Ting, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, GP at a Johor Bahru clinic. Direct, friendly; English-leaning, fluent Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Hafiz, dah sebulan makan mebeverine. Macam mana perut?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Sakit memulas tu dah kurang, doktor. Tapi cirit-birit masih ada, terutama pagi masa kat site.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Seminggu berapa hari jadi macam tu?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tiga empat hari. Kat plant tu tandas jauh, kena naik turun tangga. Kadang-kadang tak sempat, doktor. Malu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Faham. Pagi tu encik minum kopi ke?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kopi O dua cawan, lepas tu nasi lemak sambal. Rutin setiap hari.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kopi dan sambal pedas tu boleh trigger. Cuba kurangkan jadi satu cawan dulu, tengok ada beza tak.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Satu cawan boleh lah. Ada ubat lain tak, doktor, yang boleh bawa pergi site?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh. Loperamide 2mg, makan satu biji sebelum keluar ke site pada hari yang encik rasa risau. Jangan lebih dari empat biji sehari.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Dan saya nak tambah amitriptyline 10mg, satu biji malam. Dos kecil, untuk tenangkan saraf usus, bukan sebab encik gila atau depress.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ubat depression ke tu? Isteri saya mesti tanya.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Dos depression tu sepuluh kali ganda. Yang ni sikit je, untuk usus. Mungkin rasa mengantuk sikit pagi, dan mulut kering.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya kena drive jauh juga. Mengantuk tu bahaya tak?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Makan pukul lapan malam, jangan lewat. Minggu pertama kalau pagi rasa blur, jangan drive dan beritahu saya.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK doktor. Bila kena datang balik?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Empat minggu. Bawa diary, tulis apa makan dan bila cirit-birit. Senang kita nampak pattern.

patient_persona.description: Deepa a/p Subramaniam, 41, female, secondary school teacher in Ipoh; IBS with constipation, back to review a normal colonoscopy. Articulate, slightly worried, Malaysian Indian English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Rashid Othman, Malay man in his 50s, gastroenterologist at an Ipoh hospital. Warm, unhurried; English with this patient.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good morning Deepa. Your colonoscopy last week was completely normal. No polyps, no inflammation.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Thank God. I was so risau, doctor. But then why still kembung every afternoon?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That fits irritable bowel syndrome, the constipation type. The bowel is structurally fine, but it moves slowly and feels pain more easily.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: So it's all in my head? Suami saya kata saya stress sangat pasal exam sekolah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Not in your head. Stress does make it worse, through the gut-brain connection, but the symptoms are real.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: How often are you opening your bowels now?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Twice a week, kadang-kadang less. Keras macam tahi kambing. I take senna from the farmasi almost every night.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Every night for how long?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Maybe eight months. Kalau tak makan, langsung tak keluar.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Let's switch. Senna every day can cause cramping. I'll give you macrogol, Forlax, one sachet in a glass of water every morning.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Is it the same thing? Won't I get addicted?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: It works differently, it just holds water in the stool, so it's gentler. You can adjust, half sachet or two sachets depending on the stool.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Also add psyllium slowly, and walk thirty minutes after dinner. For the bloating, peppermint oil capsules, one capsule three times a day.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Peppermint I can get at Guardian, right? And the thosai and chapati, boleh makan lagi?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, eat normally. Just note which foods make the bloating worse. Come back in two months and we'll review.

patient_persona.description: Nur Syafiqah binti Abdullah, 22, female, university student in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah; first visit for alternating constipation and diarrhoea around exams. Shy, soft, fast Sabahan Malay with some English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Veronica Majinbon, Kadazan woman in her 30s, doctor at a university health centre in Kota Kinabalu. Gentle, encouraging; switches easily between Malay and English.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Syafiqah, cerita sikit apa yang kau rasa.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Perut saya selalu kembung, doktor. Kadang-kadang three days tak buang air, lepas tu tiba-tiba diarrhoea pula.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sudah berapa lama begini? Few weeks or months?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Sejak semester lepas. Masa final exam paling teruk. Sekarang midterm, mula balik.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ada darah dalam najis? Fever? Weight loss?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tiada blood. Weight macam biasa. Cuma kadang-kadang rasa nausea in the morning.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Period kau macam mana, teratur? Sakit perut ni ada kaitan dengan period?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Teratur. Tak rasa ada kaitan, doktor. Lebih kepada bila stress.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Perut kau lembut, tak ada benjolan. Saya rasa ini IBS, irritable bowel syndrome, jenis bercampur. Usus sensitif bila stress.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Bahaya ke, doktor? Kena operation ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak bahaya, dan tak perlu operation. Tapi dia boleh datang dan pergi, jadi kita kena urus.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya bagi hyoscine butylbromide, Buscopan 10mg, bila perut memulas, sampai tiga kali sehari. Untuk sembelit, Fybogel satu paket setiap malam.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Makanan kat cafe tu banyak fried and spicy food. Itu pun trigger ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh jadi trigger. Cuba makan ikut waktu, jangan skip breakfast, dan kurangkan minuman bergas. Tidur cukup juga penting.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Susah tidur cukup masa exam, doktor. Tapi saya cuba.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau stress rasa berat, kaunselor universiti ada, free. Datang balik sebulan lagi, OK?

patient_persona.description: Lau Chee Ming, 45, male, timber trading company manager in Sibu, Sarawak; follow-up and refill for diarrhoea-predominant IBS, frequent business dinners. Deep, relaxed voice, Malaysian Mandarin mixed with English and some Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Ting Huong Ling, Foochow Malaysian woman in her 40s, GP at a Sibu clinic. Practical, a little teasing; mixes Mandarin, English and Malay freely.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 刘先生，今天是来拿药的 kan？上次的 mebeverine 吃了怎样？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 有好一点。Pain 少了很多，但是应酬完 next day 早上还是拉，一个早上三次。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 应酬的时候喝什么？啤酒还是 whisky？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 都有啦，生意 kena 陪客人。一个礼拜大概三次，每次半瓶 whisky 那样。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 半瓶 is a lot. 酒精会刺激肠子，IBS 会更严重，而且你的肝指数上次有一点高。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: ALT 高一点而已嘛。医生，有没有药吃了不会拉？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 药可以帮忙，但是如果每个礼拜喝那么多，没有药 can fix it。至少减到一个礼拜一次，一两杯就好。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好啦，我试试看 lah。叫客人喝茶也可以 kot。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我继续开 mebeverine 135mg，一天三次，饭前吃。Loperamide 2mg 给你十粒，只是早上要开会或者出门的时候吃。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那个 probiotic 呢？我太太在 farmasi 买了一瓶给我，要吃吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 可以吃，some people 有帮助，不会伤身体。Try one month，没有效就不用继续浪费钱。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 大概多少钱一瓶？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Around sixty to eighty ringgit. 你自己看。另外今天顺便抽血 check 肝功能 and full blood count。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 要不要空肚？我早上吃了 kampua 面。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 这个不用空肚。三个月后回来，report 我们一起看。如果大便有血，马上回来 jangan tunggu。
